english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Four Fathers; what they are like.
english_classification.chapter_note: A remarkably pure body-cosmos correspondence teaching with minimal editorial overlay. The four-fold mapping (directive→Father, eyes→light ships, body→living soul, tongue→Jesus the Splendour) is systematic and complete. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system throughout. The only editorial material is the dialogue frame opening (¶1 attribution) and closing (¶9). The negative editorial fatigue score confirms substrate dominance increasing toward the chapter's end. 'Jesus the Splendour' functions as a cosmic emanation entity (the revealer principle) rather than a historical figure; the name may overlay an older cosmic revealer figure from the Persian tradition. The teaching structure itself—mapping four cosmic powers to four body faculties—is characteristic of the oldest correspondential substrate.
